meta.title: Lifeathlete · The life athlete

hero.eyebrow: A habit app for a balanced life
hero.title: The life athlete
hero.subtitle: Care for your 10 pillars, one day at a time.
hero.note: Free, and installable on your phone.

pillars.title: The 10 pillars
pillars.intro: A balanced life rests on ten pillars. You choose the ones you want to care for, and every habit you complete strengthens one of them.

checkin.title: Check in within seconds
checkin.body: One tap marks a habit as done. You choose the habits for each pillar and adjust the goals whenever you like.

progress.title: Earn XP, levels and streaks
progress.body: Every habit you complete earns XP. You level up, unlock medals, and your streak forgives one rest day a week.

balance.title: Balance your wheel
balance.body: The Wheel of Life shows how your pillars are doing and which one is waiting for some care, with a gentle suggestion and no pressure.

see.title: Take a look
see.intro: Today for your daily check-ins, and the Wheel of Life to see your balance.
see.sample: Real app screens, with sample data.

today.caption: Today
today.alt: The Today screen: level 4, 1240 XP and a 12-day streak, with habits grouped by pillar, some done and some still to do.

wheel.caption: Wheel of Life
wheel.alt: The Wheel of Life screen: a radar chart of the 10 pillars' scores over the last 30 days and the list of pillars with their percentages.

dragonfly.title: Your dragonfly
dragonfly.body: It grows with you through five stages as you level up. If you take a break, it rests and waits for you: it never dies or sulks.

final.title: Start today, at your own pace
final.body: Pick the pillars you want to care for and make your first check-in.

footer.tagline: Free, installable on your phone, in Portuguese and English.
